_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run: 6 new evidence rows admitted across 4 opportunities (Census Bureau BTOS microdata x2, Gartner CHRO survey, Federal Reserve Board FEDS Note, arXiv RCT). One red-team score downgrade: coding-productivity-gains-attenuate-at-shipping 5→4 (Shen & Tamkin RCT contradicts). entry-level-hiring-contraction-mixed-evidence and genai-adoption-plateau-scaling-gap gained corroboration/breadth with no headline score change; ai-productivity-reallocated-not-cut gained corroboration (already at 4 from a prior-run contradiction downgrade, unchanged this run). Two oversized summaries (genai-adoption-plateau-scaling-gap, entry-level-hiring-contraction-mixed-evidence) were rewritten back under the 4-paragraph cap while merging in new evidence. Product Management, QA/Test Engineering, and Data Engineering searched per the coverage mandate but no qualifying (reliability ≥3, disclosed methodology) founding evidence found this run.
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
